question.text:
The correct statements among (a) to (d) regarding $\mathrm{H}_{2}$ as a fuel are :

(i) It produces less pollutants than petrol.

(ii) A cylinder of compressed dihydrogen weighs $\sim 30$ times more than a petrol tank producing the same amount of energy.

(iii) Dihydrogen is stored in tanks of metal alloys like $\mathrm{NaNi}_{5}$

(iv) On combustion, values of energy released per gram of liquid dihydrogen and LPG are 50 and $142 \mathrm{~kJ},$ respectively.
